_source: sqpat's Twitch playthrough (series 'twitch', collection i9PxK6i5nRamtQ: 349237766 Part 1 6858s, 349237819 Part 2 24319s, 349237909 Part 3 29698s, 349237884 Part 4 32371s) and WERDNAちゃんねる's YouTube stream (series 'werdna': g2wng1XNxsk 16732s, gPpYHBBKXm4 9404s, bJq1wCJ6Qqg 13674s, MLnXexuEITM 9908s). The machine readings are docs/vod_samples/{twitch,werdna}_part*.json.
_method: Frames are read by tools/vod_ocr.py (the game's font, matched cell by cell) from the downloaded video at its keyframes, and matched to a dump row by tools/vod_read.py, which names the script. 'at' is seconds from the start of the series' part 1, parts laid end to end; each series is its own timeline.
_caveat: One player's route: it shows when they chose to go somewhere, which tracks the story closely here but is not proof. Used for relative order only, interpolated onto the story counters' scale.
